pages.text: The five rolled and played on the grass. Leo kept making jokes.
Mei tripped and fell. "Look! Tripped over their own feet!"
Dry grass stuck all over Soso's spines. "Grass is growing on your head!"
Soso pressed a hand to their back, then grew quiet.
Leo made another joke. This time, nobody laughed.
The four talked among themselves. Whatever Leo said, nobody looked his way.
Grandma Bear pulled off a piece of grass. "Laughter is laughter when we all laugh together."
Leo stood in front of Soso. "I'm sorry about earlier."
Leo flopped onto the grass. Dry grass piled on his tummy. All five laughed together.
